traversal_unit: one regret traversal plus one independent average-policy pass per task

replay_sample_reference.method: matched fixed states and metadata; raw Observation versus compact NeuralObservation with identical conservative accounting

bytes_per_sample.measurement: conservative Python-owned accounting; excludes allocator and process overhead

ram_estimate.method: 3 replay copies + measured trainer/worker RSS + configured generated/pending sample budgets; allocator growth is unmodeled

runtime_estimates_seconds.method: measured throughput including root generation and spawn overhead; linear full-replay fit scaling; conservative extrapolation, not a guarantee

artifact_estimate_method: checkpoint size scaled by replay capacity and retained checkpoint count; excludes logs and allocator overhead
approval_required: Substantial pilot/full runs require explicit approval after reviewing this report
